subject.title: feat: validate required run artifacts against a schema (`--require-artifact-schema`)

question: Should Crabbox permanently own `--require-artifact-schema` and its custom fail-closed JSON Schema subset as a supported CLI and timing-report contract?
rationale: This is a new user-facing capability rather than a repair to an established contract; choosing the validation language, provider scope, exit behavior, and serialized evidence shape requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Adopt the narrow gate
options.body: Accept the proposed SSH-first flag and fail-closed subset after the parser defect and live-proof gate are satisfied.

options.title: Keep validation repo-owned
options.body: Decline the flag and continue requiring each repository command to validate its evidence before Crabbox checks file existence.

options.title: Use standard JSON Schema
options.body: Request a maintained standards implementation instead of a custom subset, accepting dependency and broader compatibility costs.

recommendation.title: Adopt the narrow gate
recommendation.body: Accept the proposed SSH-first flag and fail-closed subset after the parser defect and live-proof gate are satisfied.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent mainline artifact and CLI history makes `steipete` the strongest available owner for the permanent CLI contract choice.
